name: Earth
tagline: The only world known to harbor life — an ocean planet in the habitable zone.
history: Earth coalesced from the solar nebula about 4.54 billion years ago and cooled into a differentiated world of crust, mantle and iron core. Life appeared in its oceans within the first billion years and photosynthesis later oxygenated the atmosphere, enabling complex land ecosystems. Plate tectonics — unique among known rocky planets — continuously recycles the surface and regulates climate over geological time. Humanity has observed Earth from space since 1946; Apollo 17's 'Blue Marble' (1972) remains one of the most reproduced photographs ever taken. Over 6,000 confirmed exoplanets now provide context for just how unusual a stable, liquid-water, life-bearing world may be.
